title: Slugs, snails and chewing caterpillars
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
summary: Combine night inspection, barriers and targeted removal.
steps: Identify feeding pattern and inspect at dusk, night or early morning when the pest is active.
Remove hiding boards, dense debris and weeds immediately beside vulnerable seedlings.
Hand-pick safely with gloves or use crop covers that do not trap pests underneath.
Check covers after wind and remove them when pollination access is required.
Use only a product explicitly labelled for the crop and pest, and protect children, pets and wildlife.
